source:
@@U02326@@
Let everyone choose what he likes best!
And be swift about it,
so every arbor and corridor becomes a garden!
Draw round,
for both the girls and their goods
are worthy closer inspection.

@@U02328@@
We make our sales, delightfully playing,
So let there be no haggling here;
Let each one know just what you're saying,
And make a purchase without fear.

@@U02329@@
(The FLOWER GIRLS daintily lay out their wares under the green arbors.)

@@U02331@@
(Singing to bass lutes.)

@@U02332@@
Flowers, there, where you have placed them,
Charmingly your heads adorn,
So our fruits you will not scorn;
They'll delight you, if you taste them.
King plums, cherries, ripened peaches,
We sun-bronzed workers bid you buy!
The worst of judges is the eye,
So trust what tongue or palate teaches.
Come, come all with gladdening eyes,
To a feast we you invite;
A rose you can always poetize,
But an apple you must bite.
You, now in the bloom of youth,
Let us join you in your labors,
Let us build our booth by your booth,
As is only right for neighbors.
Beneath these arbors with festoons wound,
In the shade of peach-hung bowers,
Everything you want is found,
Buds and petals, fruit and flowers.
translation:
@@U02326@@
让每个人都选择自己最喜欢的！
并且动作要快，
所以每个凉亭和走廊都变成了花园！
画圆，
对于女孩和她们的货物
都值得仔细检查。

@@U02328@@
我们愉快地进行销售，
所以这里不要讨价还价；
让每个人都知道你在说什么
并毫无恐惧地进行购买。

@@U02329@@
（花姑娘们优雅地将她们的商品摆在绿色的凉亭下。）

@@U02331@@
（用低音鲁特琴唱歌。）

@@U02332@@
鲜花，在那里，你放置它们的地方，
你的头饰迷人，
所以我们的果实你不会轻视；
如果您品尝它们，它们会让您感到高兴。
王李、樱桃、成熟的桃子，
我们晒成古铜色的工人叫你买！
最糟糕的评委是眼睛
因此，请相信舌头或味觉的教导。
来吧，带着喜悦的目光来吧，
您邀请我们参加一场盛宴；
一朵你总能诗意的玫瑰，
但你必须咬一个苹果。
正值青春年华的你，
让我们加入您的工作，
让我们在您的展位旁搭建我们的展位，
只适合邻居。
在这些缠绕着花彩的凉亭下，
桃花凉亭荫下，
你想要的一切都可以找到
花蕾和花瓣，果实和花朵。
